activate_quest.summary: Referee: put one of the adventure's quests into play.

add_journal_entry.summary: Referee: add a line of story text to the session's journal.

add_member.summary: Referee: add a character to the party during play.

advance_time.summary: Referee: move the game clock forward.

award_xp.summary: Referee: give one character experience points, apart from the XP the session awards.

complete_objective.summary: Referee: mark one objective of an active quest complete.

complete_quest.summary: Referee: complete an active quest, and the adventure when the quest concludes it.

end_encounter.summary: Referee: close the open encounter when the party talks its way past or walks away.

grant_coins.summary: Referee: put coins straight into a member's purse.

grant_item.summary: Referee: put an item straight into a member's pack.

identify_item.summary: Referee: identify a magic item without the party having to use it.

mark_trigger_fired.summary: Referee: record that a trigger has fired.

place_party.summary: Referee: move the party straight to a dungeon cell or to town.

record_note.summary: Referee: write a note into the logs, with no effect on the game.

remove_coins.summary: Referee: take coins out of a member's purse, the inverse of `GrantCoins`.

remove_item.summary: Referee: take an item away from a member, the inverse of `GrantItem`.

remove_member.summary: Referee: take a member out of the party for good.

reveal_objective.summary: Referee: show the players a hidden objective of an active quest.

roll_dice.summary: Referee: roll dice through the session, so the roll is seeded, logged, and replayed.

set_door_state.summary: Referee: change the state of a door on any level of any dungeon.

set_flag.summary: Referee: set a session flag, like one that records a lever pulled to open a portcullis.

spawn_monsters.summary: Referee: create monsters at a distance from the party, in a new encounter or the open one.

spawn_npc_party.summary: Referee: generate a party of NPC adventurers and open an encounter with them.
